title: What to say to a recruiter on LinkedIn if you need more details about the role
description: We’ve gone over what to say to a recruiter on LinkedIn if you’re interested in the position, but what do you say back if you need more details about the role? Here’s a script you can use! Head to your Teal Job Tracker for more free email and LinkedIn templates to use at each stage of your job search. #linkedin #linkedintips #jobsearch #careeradvice
